title: My project after 9 months of development: Still Breathing
author: ThePunisher2072
selftext:
Still Breathing - a Narrative survival horror where you have to keep your family alive is being developed by me and me son. Together we’re creating a dark grim adventure with resource management, moral decisions and an immersive exploration mode. 

I’ve used all the technologies available + my knowledge in every design and sound design área of 30 years of experience. 

We are now working on the first public demo which will be available soon. 

If you want to know more: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4594740/Still\_Breathing/
